list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE model != '' UNION ALL SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE model != '') ORDER BY model

list.name: api_key
list.label: Client API Key
list.query: SELECT k AS __text, k AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') AS k FROM llm_gateway.request_log) ORDER BY k

list.name: include_local
list.label: Local models
list.description: Include models served from local/non-vendor infra (conf/providers local: true, synced to llm_gateway.model_registry)

panels.title: Score Cards (hover for decomposition)
panels.description: The Overall Score as flat cards: score headline, verdict-colored accent (good >= 70, mixed 40-69, poor < 40), PAI and request count underneath. Hover a card for the full scorecard row: each rate with its index, PAI, friction context. Rendered by the Business Text panel (grafana/business-text, Apache-2.0, preinstalled via GF_PLUGINS_PREINSTALL -- bare IDs only, the env var has no version-pin syntax) from the same score-family query as p40/p41 -- one query, no hub or synthetic edges. Template HTML passes Grafana's DOMPurify sanitizer; disable_sanitize_html remains false. Same >=30-request gate and Local models toggle. Behavioral heuristic built from your reactions, not a benchmark.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), sig AS (SELECT model, count() AS reqs, countIf(is_followup = 1) AS fu, countIf(is_followup = 1 AND signal_count > 0) AS rej_n, sum(guard_blocks + user_rejections + rule_denials) AS fric FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), spd AS (SELECT model, countIf(is_stream = 1) AS streams, countIf(aborted = 1) AS cancels, countIf(aborted = 2) AS aborts FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), sess AS (SELECT session_id, argMax(model, timestamp) AS last_model, groupUniqArray(model) AS models FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) GROUP BY session_id), swm AS (SELECT m AS model, countIf(last_model != m) AS switches, count() AS n FROM sess ARRAY JOIN models AS m WHERE m IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY m), raw AS (SELECT s.model AS model, s.reqs, 100 * s.rej_n / nullIf(s.fu, 0) AS net_rej, 100 * w.switches / nullIf(w.n, 0) AS switch_rate, 100 * p.cancels / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS cancel_rate, 100 * p.aborts / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS abort_rate, 100 * s.fric / s.reqs AS fric_rate FROM sig s INNER JOIN spd p ON p.model = s.model LEFT JOIN swm w ON w.model = s.model), idx AS (SELECT model, reqs, net_rej, switch_rate, cancel_rate, abort_rate, fric_rate, ifNull(least(greatest(1 - net_rej / 50, 0.05), 1), 0.5) AS rej_i, ifNull(least(greatest(1 - switch_rate / 100, 0.05), 1), 0.5) AS sw_i, ifNull(least(greatest(1 - cancel_rate / 5, 0.05), 1), 0.5) AS canc_i, ifNull(least(greatest(1 - abort_rate / 5, 0.05), 1), 0.5) AS ab_i FROM raw), scored AS (SELECT model, reqs, net_rej, switch_rate, cancel_rate, abort_rate, fric_rate, rej_i, sw_i, canc_i, ab_i, 100 * power(rej_i * sw_i * canc_i, 1 / 3) AS pai, 100 * sqrt(power(rej_i * sw_i * canc_i, 1 / 3) * ab_i) AS overall, multiIf(100 * sqrt(power(rej_i * sw_i * canc_i, 1 / 3) * ab_i) >= 70, 'good', 100 * sqrt(power(rej_i * sw_i * canc_i, 1 / 3) * ab_i) >= 40, 'mixed', 'poor') AS verdict FROM idx) SELECT model, verdict, round(overall, 1) AS score, round(pai, 1) AS pai, reqs, concat(toString(round(net_rej, 2)), '% (idx ', toString(round(rej_i, 2)), ')') AS rej, concat(toString(round(switch_rate, 2)), '% (idx ', toString(round(sw_i, 2)), ')') AS sw, concat(toString(round(cancel_rate, 2)), '% (idx ', toString(round(canc_i, 2)), ')') AS canc, concat(toString(round(abort_rate, 2)), '% (idx ', toString(round(ab_i, 2)), ')') AS ab, round(fric_rate, 2) AS fric FROM scored WHERE reqs >= 30 AND ('${include_local}' = 'yes' OR model NOT IN (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.model_registry WHERE is_local = 1)) ORDER BY overall DESC

panels.title: Overall Score (adherence x reliability, geometric)
panels.description: Overall = sqrt(Adherence x Reliability), multiplied geometrically so one good factor cannot buy back a bad one. Adherence combines three rates measured on your own follow-up messages: follow-up rejection (goalpost 50%), switching away mid-session (100%) and client cancels (5%); Reliability covers provider aborts (5%). A measured factor that hits its goalpost floors at 0.05 instead of zeroing the whole score; a factor with no data counts neutral (0.5). Local models (llamafile etc.) can be hidden with the Local models toggle. Based on >= 30 requests per model. This is a behavioral heuristic built from your reactions, not a benchmark.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), sig AS (SELECT model, count() AS reqs, countIf(is_followup = 1) AS fu, countIf(is_followup = 1 AND signal_count > 0) AS rej_n, countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1) AS base_n, countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1 AND signal_count > 0) AS base_rej FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), spd AS (SELECT model, countIf(is_stream = 1) AS streams, countIf(aborted = 1) AS cancels, countIf(aborted = 2) AS aborts FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), sess AS (SELECT session_id, argMax(model, timestamp) AS last_model, groupUniqArray(model) AS models FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) GROUP BY session_id), swm AS (SELECT m AS model, countIf(last_model != m) AS switches, count() AS n FROM sess ARRAY JOIN models AS m WHERE m IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY m), raw AS (SELECT s.model AS model, s.reqs, 100 * s.rej_n / nullIf(s.fu, 0) AS net_rej, 100 * w.switches / nullIf(w.n, 0) AS switch_rate, 100 * p.cancels / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS cancel_rate, 100 * p.aborts / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS abort_rate FROM sig s INNER JOIN spd p ON p.model = s.model LEFT JOIN swm w ON w.model = s.model) SELECT model AS metric, round(100 * sqrt(power(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - net_rej / 50, 0.05), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - switch_rate / 100, 0.05), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - cancel_rate / 5, 0.05), 1), 0.5), 1 / 3) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - abort_rate / 5, 0.05), 1), 0.5)), 2) AS "Overall Score" FROM raw WHERE reqs >= 30 AND ('${include_local}' = 'yes' OR model NOT IN (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.model_registry WHERE is_local = 1)) ORDER BY "Overall Score" DESC

panels.title: Session Depth by Model (avg messages/session)
panels.description: Average conversation turns per session, per model. Deeper sessions usually mean you kept working with the model instead of giving up on it, so this is a soft acceptance proxy. Migrated history is included (one row per assistant generation).

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), sessions AS (SELECT model, session_id, count() AS msgs FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id != '' AND model != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) GROUP BY model, session_id) SELECT model, round(avg(msgs), 2) AS "Avg Messages per Session" FROM sessions WHERE model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model ORDER BY "Avg Messages per Session" DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top User Rejection Strings (censored)
panels.description: The exact words that fired rejection detection, ranked by how often they occurred. Profanity is censored to first/last letter; frustration phrases are shown as written. Every occurrence counts, so one ranting session can dominate a term.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT * FROM (SELECT concat(substring(term, 1, 1), '***', substring(term, length(term), 1)) AS "Rejection String", 'Profanity' AS "Category", count() AS "Occurrences" FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(profane_terms) AS term FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)) GROUP BY term UNION ALL SELECT term AS "Rejection String", 'Frustration phrase' AS "Category", count() AS "Occurrences" FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(frustration_terms) AS term FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)) GROUP BY term) ORDER BY "Occurrences" DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Friction Rate (per 100 requests, stacked)
panels.description: How often tool actions hit friction, per 100 requests: guard-blocked commands, tool calls you rejected by hand, and calls denied by your own rules. Stacked by class so you can see which kind dominates. Buckets with under 5 requests are hidden. These counts are a lower bound: a rejection can end a turn without producing another logged request.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'guard blocks' AS label, round(100 * sum(guard_blocks) / count(), 3) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY time

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'user rejections' AS label, round(100 * sum(user_rejections) / count(), 3) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY time

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'rule denials' AS label, round(100 * sum(rule_denials) / count(), 3) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Guard Rules (ranked by blocked occurrences)
panels.description: Which shell-guard rules fire most often, extracted from BLOCKED markers in stored conversations. If a rule you actually need keeps appearing here, consider narrowing it. Models with under 100 responses are excluded.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT rule AS "Rule", count() AS "Occurrences" FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(guard_rules) AS rule FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)) GROUP BY rule ORDER BY "Occurrences" DESC LIMIT 15
